# ascii/ui

> shadcn-style UI components in a brutalist ASCII skin: frames, fills and shadows are strings of characters, weight is character density, underneath it is plain accessible HTML. Two kit files (CSS and JS, no dependencies, no build step) you link, then paste a component's HTML. Live at https://ascii.fedekotek.design. MIT license.

The repo holds two things. The site (`index.html`, `css/`, `js/`, built into one HTML file by `build.py`) documents and demos the components. The kit (`kit/`) is what people link from their own pages. The site does not load the kit; its Code tab prints the kit's HTML, CSS and JS for each component. 34 components, 32 in the kit (Command and Picture are site only).

## The five views

- [Home](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#home): the ring (a glitching torus hero), where to start, questions, a game of invaders.
- [Components](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components): Get the kit, then 34 components in five groups (Form, Overlay, Display, Feedback, Navigation), each with Preview and Code tabs, then Rules.
- [Blocks](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#blocks): 16 page-sized compositions (login, stats, table, pricing, settings, a portfolio).
- [Charts](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#charts): 5 character-grid charts (bars, line, regions, heatmap, donut).
- [Themes](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#themes): presets, color pickers, the ramp editor, tokens to paste, Labs.

Every section has an address: `#components/button`, `#themes/tokens`.

## Kit files

- [ascii-ui.css](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/ascii-ui.css): tokens, frame strings, one block per part. Latest.
- [ascii-ui.js](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/ascii-ui.js): the behaviors, wired by `data-aui` attributes; `window.ASCIIUI`. Latest.
- Pinned copies live under a version path that never changes, `https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/1.2.0/ascii-ui.css` and `https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/1.2.0/ascii-ui.js`. 1.0.0, 1.1.0, 1.1.1 and 1.2.0 are there; the [kit CHANGELOG](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/CHANGELOG.md) lists every version and what changed.
- [starter.html](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/starter.html): a page that links the two files and nothing else, with every kit component on it.
- [kit README](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/README.md): the reference for the kit: install, attributes, `window.ASCIIUI` API, events, lifecycle, theming, versions, changelog.
- [Single file](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/ascii-ui.html): the whole site as one HTML file.
- [llms-full.txt](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/llms-full.txt): every component in full, when to use it, its states, keys and the HTML to paste.
- The font is Geist Mono, in `kit/fonts/` (SIL OFL 1.1). The MIT license is [LICENSE.txt](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/LICENSE.txt), also next to the kit files.

## Install

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/ascii-ui.css">
<script defer src="https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/ascii-ui.js"></script>
```

Then copy a component's HTML from its Code tab, or from `docs/COMPONENTS-REFERENCE.md` in the repo. The HTML has no ids; the kit makes the ones accessibility needs, so a component pasted twice is two working copies. Elements added later are wired too. Dark follows the system; `<html data-theme="dark">` or `"light"` forces one.

## Attributes (summary; kit/README.md has the full table)

| Attribute | On | Does |
|---|---|---|
| `data-aui="tabs"` | `role="tablist"` | click, arrows, Home, End pick a tab |
| `data-aui="slider"` | `.slider` | draws the halftone bar from the range, fills the `<output>` |
| `data-aui="progress"` | `role="progressbar"` | draws the bar from `aria-valuenow` |
| `data-aui="dropdown"` | `.pop` | the `aria-haspopup` button opens the `role="menu"`, arrows move, Escape closes |
| `data-aui="tooltip"` | `.pop` | tap to show, Escape to hide (hover and focus are CSS) |
| `data-aui="otp"` | `.otp` | advances, Backspace goes back, takes a paste |
| `data-aui="calendar"` | empty element | draws the month, keyboard by day, week and month |
| `data-aui="pagination"` | `<nav>` | draws pages from `data-pages` and `data-page` |
| `data-aui="validate"` | `<input>` in `.field` | checks `required`, `pattern`, `type`, writes to the nearest `.error` |
| `data-aui="counter"` | `<textarea>` | counts against `maxlength` into the nearest `.count` |
| `data-aui="spinner"` | `<b>` or `<span>` | `data-kind`: classic, ramp, bounce, dots or fill |
| `data-aui="skeleton"` | `<pre class="skel">` | a card silhouette with a wave |
| `data-aui-open` / `data-aui-close` | button | opens the nearest `<dialog>`, closes its dialog |
| `data-aui-toast` / `data-aui-toast-err` | button | lime toast / yellow toast |
| `data-aui-reset`, `data-aui-fill` | button | puts the fields of its form or dialog back to what the HTML says; runs the nearest progress bar |

The nearest `role="status"` says what happened. Components fire bubbling `aui:*` events.

## Color roles

Magenta (`--hot`) acts. Cyan (`--cy`) is focus and nothing else. Lime (`--ok`) confirms. Yellow (`--warn`) warns. Violet and deep (`--violet`, `--deep`) are structure and shadows, pink (`--pink`) is secondary emphasis. Action and warning must stay distinct. Motion is `steps()`, never eased. Everything snaps to a grid of `1ch` by one row (`--r`, 21px, 14px type).

## Where the tokens live

- `css/01-tokens.css`: the site's tokens, light on `:root`, dark twice (by system and by `data-theme="dark"`).
- `kit/ascii-ui.css`, the `tokens` block: the kit's copy. Override on `:root` after the file.
- `css/15-themes-menu.css`: the presets. Every other place a color is written: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, Rebrand.

## Work on it

- Run: `python3 -m http.server 8000`, or open `index.html` from `file://`.
- After editing `kit/`: `python3 qa/kit.py sync` (the Code tab reads a copy of the kit embedded in `js/40-themes-ramp-code.js`).
- After changing a component: `python3 qa/reference.py`.
- Ship: `python3 build.py`, then the release bar, `sh qa/release.sh`, which must end with `release: ok`. Commit `site/` and `dist/`; Vercel deploys `main`.
- Rules: no frameworks, no dependencies, no bundler; works from `file://`; reduced motion stops every animation and sound; no em dashes, no emojis, metric units.

## Docs in the repo

These live in the repo, not on the site, so they are plain paths from the repo root, not links. Only the kit files, the starter page, llms.txt and the site itself are published.

- `CLAUDE.md`: the rules, the short component checklist, the release bar. Read first.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: load order, page skeleton, navigation, grid, the kit and the Code tab, versions, shipping, Rebrand.
- `docs/COMPONENTS.md`: what the Code tab prints, the component table, the add-a-component checklist.
- `docs/COMPONENTS-REFERENCE.md`: every component's printed HTML, behaviors and CSS blocks. Generated.
- `docs/API.md`: the site's JS surface (`window.AUI` and friends), Search commands, data attributes, and a pointer to `window.ASCIIUI`.
- `docs/TOKENS.md`: colors, ramp, tones, presets.
- `docs/EFFECTS.md`: every trick, how it works, what breaks it.
- `docs/BLOCKS.md` and `docs/CHARTS.md`: the blocks and charts, with recipes.
- `docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`: what is fragile.
- `docs/DECISIONS.md`, `docs/ROADMAP.md`, `docs/CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- `qa/README.md`: every QA script and the release bar.
- `kit/README.md`: the kit reference, also published at https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/README.md.
